headline: Boundary realignment recommendations, a $500,000 Nellie Mae grant, and a petition on the Worcester Arts Magnet School lottery.
summary: The agenda also includes a $2,200 music therapy grant for Worcester Arts Magnet School students and a report on Improving Tier I Instruction. Several items would be sent to committees, including proposed new courses and a review of art and music offerings.
items: Contract negotiation strategy with the Educational Association of Worcester, in executive session
Four donations, including $6,500 in gift cards for Coats for Kids
Notification of new hire and resignation/retirement personnel records
Initial filing of recognition for two educators from South High and Doherty Memorial
Public petition on keeping the citywide lottery at Worcester Arts Magnet School and related boundary changes
$500,000 Community District Grant from the Nellie Mae Foundation
$2,200 Kate's Voice grant for music therapy at Worcester Arts Magnet School
DESE financial review of the Massachusetts Education Collaborative
Full analysis of art and music offerings by school and grade
Instructional unit on safe use of bicycles, e-bikes, scooters, and e-scooters
location: Esther Howland Chamber, Worcester City Hall, Main Street, Worcester, with a virtual option on Zoom
item_action_words: Recommendation: Approve report and file item
